biotools.summary: ApreciseKUre is a digital platform designed to facilitate data collection, integration, and analysis for patients affected by Alkaptonuria (AKU). It incorporates genetic, biochemical, histopathological, clinical, and therapeutic resources to support precision medicine approaches.
